name: Matrix
summary: A matrix question on the audience phone: one labelled group of answer rows per statement, a single or multiple pick per row, laid out top to bottom so a 360px phone never scrolls sideways.
highlights: Rows x columns question on the audience phone
Single or multiple pick per row
Built from Answer option rows, 48px targets
Locks and restores the value after an iframe remount
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-matrix> — for a matrix question on the audience phone of a slide type or survey. Each row (a statement) is a labelled group of <aha-answer-option> rows, one per column, so the grid reads top to bottom on a phone; wider hosts flow the columns side by side. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Row label
spec.value: 16px / 24px, 600, deck ink; wraps, never truncates; dir=auto for right-to-left text

spec.label: Columns
spec.value: one Answer option row per column (min-height 48, radius 8, frosted surface); 8px between them; side by side only when each gets at least 200px, so a phone stacks them

spec.label: Pick
spec.value: radio rows (single, arrow keys move and pick inside one row) or checkbox rows (multiple); Tab moves to the next statement

spec.label: Locked
spec.value: disabled or a locked lock-key: every row shows the Answer option locked look, the picks stay at full strength

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: rows
props.desc: The statements. A plain string's id is its index. Also the `rows` property

props.name: columns
props.desc: The answer scale shared by every row. A plain string's id is its index. Also the `columns` property

props.name: selection-mode
props.desc: One column per row (radio rows) or several (checkbox rows)

props.name: value
props.desc: The picks; rows with no pick are left out. Also the `value` property

props.name: group-label
props.desc: The accessible name of the whole question: pass the translated question

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Shows the locked look and ignores picks

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted value, including after an iframe remount

props.name: change
props.desc: Fires on every pick with the whole value and the row and column just picked

whenToUse.when: several statements rated on the same set of answers (a satisfaction grid, a Likert block)
one question with a fixed set of answers
a numeric 0-10 score (Number scale) or free text

opinion.note: Replaces a hand-built table of radio buttons, which scrolls sideways on a phone and loses the deck ink, the frosted surface and the submission lock. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
